name: Stand-Up India Scheme
summary: Bank loans from Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for SC, ST and women entrepreneurs setting up their first venture in manufacturing, services, trading or activities allied to agriculture.
administering_ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
implementing_agency: Scheduled commercial banks, through the Stand-Up Mitra portal
benefit_description: Composite loan of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore covering 75% of the project cost, including term loan and working capital.

criteria.description: The borrower must belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe, or be a woman entrepreneur.
criteria.source_quote: Facilitates bank loans between 10 lakh and 1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.

criteria.description: The enterprise must be greenfield, meaning this is the beneficiary's first venture in manufacturing, services or trading.
criteria.source_quote: Green field signifies, in this context, the first time venture of the beneficiary in the manufacturing or services or trading sector.

criteria.description: For a non-individual enterprise, at least 51% of the shareholding and controlling stake must be held by SC, ST or women entrepreneurs.
criteria.source_quote: In case of non-individual enterprises, 51% of the shareholding and controlling stake should be held by either SC/ST and/or Women Entrepreneur.

criteria.description: The borrower should not be in default to any bank or financial institution.

document_requirements.document_name: Caste certificate (for SC or ST applicants)
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Apply at the tehsil or district office, or via your state e-district portal. Not required for women applicants claiming on gender alone.

document_requirements.issuing_authority_name: Prepared by the applicant, often with a chartered accountant
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Prepared in-house or by a CA. The Stand-Up Mitra portal offers handholding support to help prepare it.

document_requirements.document_name: PAN of the applicant and the entity
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Apply online through the Income Tax e-filing portal or NSDL.

windows.notes: No fixed window. Applications are routed to banks through the Stand-Up Mitra portal at any time.

benefits.description: Composite bank loan of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore, typically covering up to 75% of project cost.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: This is credit, not a grant: it carries interest and repayment obligations. Disbursed by the lending bank after sanction.
benefits.source_quote: The objective of Stand-Up India scheme is to facilitate bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and Woman borrower for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
